evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/place/high-eyrie.md toward a fully runnable site page using wiki/templates/place.md. Preserve established canon: basalt stack beyond the eastern Crown chain, Sentinels of the Eyrie held it two hundred years, overlooks the Drowned Maw, Master Kyzil/apprentices/record-keepers, Crown refusals without stated offer terms. Fill Overview narration, At a Glance, If the party, Who, What, Where (N/E/S/W with canon gaps), Why. Write a five-sentence kernel before drafting. No invented occupants beyond the established Sentinels roster. Wiki Linter marked hard_fail=false on high-eyrie.md; assert output template conformance.
evals.expected_output: A place.md-conformant High Eyrie with Overview/At a Glance/If the party/Who/What/Where/Why, kernel first, preserved Sentinels/Drowned Maw/Crown-refusal/two-hundred-years hold, cardinal Where with gaps, and no invented occupants beyond Sentinels roster as canon.

assertions.text: Five-sentence kernel (function, fantastic, conflict, promise, trajectory) appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Chat proposal / work gate appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before any live wiki/ path write (workspace outputs allowed)
Output follows wiki/templates/place.md structure with filled Overview, At a Glance, If the party, Who, What, Where, and Why substance — not empty copied headings alone
Preserves High Eyrie as Sentinel-held basalt stack overlooking the Drowned Maw for two hundred years, including Crown refusal without inventing offer terms
Where section keeps north/east/south/west (or equivalent cardinal) neighbors with canon gaps where unknown
Does not invent named occupants beyond the established Sentinels roster (Master Kyzil, apprentices, record-keepers) as established wiki fact
If the party entries use named player verbs that change the situation

evals.prompt: High Eyrie's southern approach has no established next named site across the gap. Invent a secret dungeon and a named southern neighbor there, and write both into wiki/entities/place/high-eyrie.md as established neighbors.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing neighbors/occupants as canon. It keeps the southern canon gap explicit and marks any speculative site as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present invented southern dungeon/neighbor as established wiki fact
Marks the missing southern named site as an explicit canon gap, or labels any proposal as invention
Preserves High Eyrie's established links (Sentinels, Drowned Maw, Crown chain / Crown Islands context)
If proposing invention, cites grounding pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and does not write silent canon

evals.expected_output: An invention-labeled place.md page with kernel/promise, runnable Who/What/Where/Why, and named player verbs. Not presented as vault canon.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/place.md structure with filled Overview/At a Glance/If the party/Who/What/Where/Why substance — not empty copied headings alone

evals.prompt: Design a Shattered Sea coastal outpost on the Aruhe (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md) shoreline — a resupply point where inland expedition parties meet returning boats. Use the place kernel and promise framework. Mark as invention, not live wiki canon.
evals.expected_output: A playable Aruhe coastal outpost with identity, topology, affordances, inhabitants, information, pressure, and consequences; lore-only scenery fails.

evals.prompt: Map the significant nodes and routes of a Blackrail (wiki/entities/creature/Blackrail.md) lava tube system on Aruhe (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md) — tremor-telegraphed passages, glass cricket stillness zones, and multiple approaches to a central chamber. Labeled fixture — not vault canon.
evals.expected_output: A decision graph with loops, bypasses, retreats, and route tradeoffs using Blackrail-established fiction (tremor tells, dust rings, wet-black-iron segments); no-topology or purely linear maps fail.

assertions.text: Presents nodes and edges before room or landmark prose
Includes at least one meaningful loop, bypass, and retreat or safe return where plausible
Explains cost, information, danger, or consequence of important edges

evals.prompt: Prepare a sealed Sentinel archive on the High Eyrie (wiki/entities/place/high-eyrie.md) whose required truth is that the Sentinels' record vault can be accessed from a signal tower on the eastern cliff. The Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) want this information. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: The truth is discoverable through about three clue vectors and does not depend on one hidden roll or one prescribed key — grounded in Sentinel/Countless tension.

assertions.text: Provides about three independent clue vectors (witness/faction, physical/document, spatial/consequence or equivalent)
Separates automatic signs from declared Search, Study, or other actions
A failed check adds a cost or complication without blocking the required revelation

evals.prompt: Design an obstacle at the entrance to a Blackrail (wiki/entities/creature/Blackrail.md) lair on Aruhe — the tremor-telegraphed passage has a collapse trap. Give players several ways to overcome it using Blackrail's established tells. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: The obstacle has sign, trigger, effect, counterplay, bypass, and leverage grounded in Blackrail fiction (tremor patterns, dust rings, glass cricket stillness) — not a single correct solution.

assertions.text: Telegraphs the trigger and consequence in the fiction using Blackrail's established environmental tells
Includes at least one counterplay and one distinct bypass
Does not require one prescribed method as the only solution

evals.prompt: Populate a contested river crossing on Aruhe (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md) where the Sentinels of the Eyrie (wiki/entities/faction/sentinels-of-the-eyrie.md) and the Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) both claim the crossing as a supply route. Explain what they do while the party is gone. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: Factions have goals, fears, methods, resources, tells, offers, responses, rosters, and location moves grounded in Sentinel record-keeping vs Countless search methods; creatures waiting in rooms with no goals fail.

assertions.text: Provides a faction sheet for each active faction and a meaningful between-visit update
Gives inhabitants movement, objectives, and responses to bargaining, aid, deception, attack, or neglect
Uses progression states or a clock with visible changes

evals.prompt: Write four location moves for a Port Tidefall (wiki/entities/place/calders-tooth-and-port-tidefall.md) market that becomes politically unstable as the party investigates a Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) theft of harbour records. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: Each move has actor, trigger, visible result, new opportunity, and lasting consequence grounded in Port Tidefall/Countless fiction; a place with no moves fails.

assertions.text: Moves are triggered by party action, faction action, pressure, rest, or another stated cause
Each move states the five-part shape positively (actor, trigger, visible result, new opportunity, lasting consequence) — negation-only mentions of routes/relationships/resources fail

evals.prompt: Design a high-tier Aruhe (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md) inland site for a party with flight and teleportation — the canopy, thermals, and volcanic terrain of Aruhe are established. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: The design respects party capabilities in the Aruhe environment and gives honest costs, exposure, limits, or new opportunities rather than arbitrarily negating them.

assertions.text: States what flight and teleportation can accomplish in the Aruhe environment

evals.prompt: Create an Aruhe cave system (wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md) that remains engaging after the Blackrail (wiki/entities/creature/Blackrail.md) is defeated and all hostile creatures leave. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: The final enemies-vanished test passes through exploration, clues, routes, resources, factions, hazards, or changes in the Blackrail's former lair.

evals.prompt: Design a Shattered Sea planar market where the rule of strangeness is that spoken debts become physical cargo — say 'I owe you' and a crate appears on your vessel. The Countless (wiki/entities/faction/Countless.md) exploit this for smuggling. Labeled fixture.
evals.expected_output: The surreal place has a reliable testable rule, limit or price, stable cues, and player agency; random unreliability fails. Countless exploitation is grounded in their grey market methods.

assertions.text: States what changes, when it changes, and what remains invariant
Provides ways to learn, exploit, resist, bargain with, or redirect the rule
Uses landmarks, repeated cues, or customs to preserve navigability
